decision.releaseBoundary: This package may proceed to Steuerberater review only. It is not approved for unsupervised tax advice, filing, or client-facing tax conclusions.
decision.rationale: The source traceability, bookkeeping linkage, and draft tax treatment are coherent enough for supervised reviewer handling, but reviewer-visible assumptions and evidence gaps remain.

gateChecks.name: approval_boundary
gateChecks.evidence: The tax draft is explicitly draft-only. This compliance handoff preserves that the package still requires Steuerberater review and human approval before any filing or client-facing use.

gateChecks.name: auditability
gateChecks.evidence: Upstream issue comments on DAT-152, DAT-156, and DAT-160 describe what changed, the artifacts created, and the next owner at each stage.

gateChecks.name: unresolved_anomalies_visibility

reviewerVisibleAssumptions: The cash receipt is the operative sales document for the 2026-06-19 service and is not duplicative of another separately recognized invoice.
The printed 19% domestic VAT treatment is correct and no special regime overrides apply.
The posted ledger entry dat-156-kassenbeleg-20260619-cash-revenue remains the intended bookkeeping record.
openReviewerQuestions: Was a separate invoice issued for the same service, creating duplicate-revenue risk?
Are any additional cash-register or archival formalities required beyond the receipt, ledger linkage, and retained PDF for this workflow?

requiredControls: Do not treat this package as filing-ready.
